note: The only place the covered area lives. bbox = south, west, north, east. The OSM border relation is the real filter, the bbox only bounds the tiles. name = the --area value for the whole region. Metros are named --area values; states lists which regions a metro may keep rows from. docs/fork_guide.md explains how to change this for another area.

tahoe.note: Lake Tahoe, straddles the CA/NV line
